title: Jamaican Keto Frittata
description: A delicious keto frittata with jamaican flavors, ideal for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a medium skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped scallions, if using, and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, jamaican seasoning, and a pinch of salt.
Add the grated cheddar cheese to the bowl and whisk until combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the scallions in the skillet.
Cook the frittata for 2-3 minutes, or until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the frittata is set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the frittata from the skillet and transfer it to a plate.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the top of the frittata and serve hot.
